restore your lists. On Marshmallow (Android 6) and later, it is only
requested if you write the file to a public folder.
 Permission to run on system boot and to post notifications is only
needed to check for items which are due and that you have set an alarm
for. On Marshmallow (Android 6) and later, notification permissions
are only requested if you save a To Do item with an alarm.
 Permission to vibrate is only needed when notifying you of items
which are due and that you have set an alarm for, if you have “Alarm
vibrate” enabled in the app settings for Nougat (Android 7) or
earlier. On Oreo (Android 8) and later, alarm vibration and sounds is
managed in the system settings.
 The following permissions are added by WorkManager, a Google
library used to run the export, import, and password re-encryption
operations in the background when initiated by the user. The core
app does not use these on its own.
 Permission to view network connections, used by WorkManager to
determine the best time to schedule background tasks.
 Create any number of categories for different lists.
 Set alarms for items that are due or nearly due.
 Configure repeating items which advance their due date when completed.
 Mark items as private and optionally encrypt them with a password.
 Export lists to a local XML file.
 Import lists from either XML or a Palm Pilot data file.
 Backwards compatible with Android 5 (Lollipop) and up.

With Mullvad VPN, your traffic travels through an encrypted tunnel to one of our VPN servers and then onward to the website you are visiting.  TELEMETRY AND CRASH REPORTS 
The app collects a very minimal amount of telemetry, and it does not in any way tie it to an account number, IP or other identifiable information. Account numbers are used for authentication. If the split tunneling feature is used, then the app queries your system for a list of all installed applications. This list is only retrieved in the split tunneling view. The list of installed applications is never sent from the device.

Frequently used scans can be saved as profiles to make them easy to run repeatedly. A command creator allows interactive creation of Nmap command lines. Scan results can be saved and viewed later. fedora-packages:demorse/demorse.description: demorse is a non-interactive command line tool for decoding Morse code signals into text. demorse detects the "dihs" and "dahs" that make a Morse code character via the computer's sound card, which can be connected to a radio receiver tuned to a CW Morse code transmission or to a tone generator. Managing your utility services has never been easier. Whether you’re at home, at work, or on the go, the City Utilities of Springfield (CUS) MyAccount app puts the power of convenience right in your hands. From viewing your latest bill to reporting an outage, everything you need to manage your utility account is just a tap away. It’s the smart, simple, and secure way to stay connected with your utility services, anytime and anywhere.

● Start or Stop Service: Moving in or out? The app makes it easy to start or stop utility services without having to call or visit a service center.
● Access Customer Support: Need help? The app connects you directly to CUS customer service so you can get the assistance you need quickly and conveniently.
● Enjoy User-Friendly Navigation: With a clean, intuitive design, the app makes it easy to find what you’re looking for, whether you’re paying a bill or checking usage stats.
The City Utilities My Account app is built to support the way you live today. No more guesswork, paper clutter, or long hold times. Just a smarter, simpler way to manage your utility services from the palm of your hand.
Ready to simplify your utility experience?
Download the CUS My Account app today and put the power of utility management where it belongs; with you.

apple-itunes:905746421.description:
Evermusic Pro - Cloud & Offline Music Player for iPhone and iPad.
Stream your music library from the cloud, listen offline, and take full control of your sound — no limits, no ads. Evermusic Pro combines a powerful audio player, equalizer, playlist manager, and file organizer in one beautiful app.
• PLAY ALL AUDIO FORMATS
Evermusic Pro supports the most popular audio formats: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, AIFF, ALAC, M4B, and many others.
• CONNECT YOUR CLOUD
Create your own music streaming service by moving your music library to the cloud. Listen to your music directly from the cloud, freeing up space on your iPhone for photos and new apps. Access music from popular cloud services like iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, and many others. Privacy-focused services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive are supported as well.
• CONNECT MEDIA SERVERS
Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby media servers with your library easily.
• CONNECT YOUR COMPUTER OR NAS
Connect using SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS protocols. Advanced buffering technologies ensure smooth playback. Connect to personal NAS storage using native APIs for QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive. Import audio files from your computer using iTunes File Sharing and Wi-Fi file transfer.
• OFFLINE MUSIC
Download your favorite songs, albums, and artists to listen offline. Enable the audio player cache to automatically download recently played songs.
• AUDIO EQUALIZER
The built-in equalizer offers presets for popular music genres, plus manual settings to fine-tune your sound and boost your audio.
• GAPLESS PLAYBACK
Enjoy smooth playback with no pauses between songs, perfect for concept albums and classical music.
• CROSSFADE PLAYBACK
Enjoy continuous playback with the crossfade feature, where the next song starts before the current one ends.
• AUDIO EFFECTS
Make your music sound the way you like with built-in audio effects. Turn on volume normalization to keep every track at the same loudness, and adjust playback with reverb, delay, distortion, and spatial audio.
• MUSIC VISUALIZER
Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music. Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.
• LYRICS AND COMMENTS
View embedded timed lyrics and comments for your audio tracks. Activate the lyrics widget on the Home Screen for quick access.
• AIRPLAY & CHROMECAST
Stream music to Apple TV, smart speakers, or other devices with AirPlay or Chromecast.
• APPLE CARPLAY
Drive and listen safely with an interface designed for CarPlay.
• WIDGETS
Activate interactive Home Screen widgets for fast access to your playback queue and continue playback from the last saved position.
• AUTOMATIC SYNCHRONIZATION
Your music library automatically syncs between the cloud and your device, grouping songs by artist, album, and genre.
• AUDIOBOOKS
Use the app as an audiobook player with features like audio bookmarks, playback speed control, and media position saving.
• PLAYLISTS MANAGER
Create and manage playlists, reorder songs, and make playlists available offline. Sort songs by name, size, track number, or album.
• ID3 TAGS EDITOR
Edit audio tags to view detailed metadata or correct corrupted information in your files.
• FILE MANAGER
Organize, move, rename, and manage your audio files directly in the app.
• ADVANCED SEARCH
The smart search engine helps you find your favorite albums, artists, and songs in your music library.
• USB FLASH CARDS
Connect external card readers like the SanDisk iXpand and listen to music directly from your SD card.
----------
Evermusic Pro is your all-in-one music player, cloud streamer, downloader, and file manager for iPhone and iPad. 
Great for music lovers, bands, producers, audiophiles, students, and audiobook listeners.
